response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT site_count, site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT site_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(site_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
